# devin-metrics

> Local-only metrics for Devin usage: sessions per day/week, cost and token aggregates per project and model, longest sessions, and tool-call mix.

devin-metrics answers "what did my Devin usage cost?" Devin sessions accumulate real cost in tokens, model time, and tool calls, but there is no built-in way to see weekly spend or which project eats the budget. The data already sits on disk in `sessions.db` and `acp-messages/*.db`; devin-metrics is the read side that turns it into summaries, per-project tables, daily activity, and a standalone HTML dashboard. It is for Devin CLI/Desktop users who want usage and cost visibility with zero telemetry: all computation is local, nothing is sent anywhere. Unofficial community tooling, not affiliated with Cognition AI.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Icaro0310/devin-metrics/blob/main/README.md): full documentation

## Key commands

- `pipx install "devin-metrics @ git+https://github.com/Icaro0310/devin-metrics.git"`: install (Python >= 3.10)
- `devin-metrics summary`: headline numbers and top-5 lists
- `devin-metrics projects`: per-project cost/session table
- `devin-metrics daily --days 14`: activity over time
- `devin-metrics dashboard --out usage.html`: write a standalone HTML dashboard
- `devin-dashboard build --out usage.html`: dashboard executable alias shipped by the same package
- `devin-dashboard data --json`: normalized stats payload as JSON
- `devin-metrics summary --json`: raw JSON for scripting

## When to use / when not

- Use when: you want to know cost/token totals per project, model, or day; you need a scriptable JSON feed of usage stats; you want a self-contained HTML dashboard of your activity; you want all of it computed locally with no telemetry.
- Not when: you need to search message content (use devin-search); you need relationship queries between sessions, files, and tools (use devin-graph); your `sessions.db` schema is outside v15-v17 (refused loudly); you need real-time live monitoring (use devin-office); there is no Devin install on the machine (nothing to measure).
